# Handbook coverage

This generated maintenance map links each current skill to its reader-facing home.

| Skill | Reader | Problem | Guide | Reference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| adddomainexperts | Engineer or technical lead shaping a change | Use this skill when general engineering personas are not enough. It identifies the project's subject domain and adds local expert personas, such as accounting, clinical, geospatial or numerical-methods reviewers, with clear peer and adversary roles. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#design) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-adddomainexperts) |
| addpacktorepo | Repository maintainer or first-time adopter | Use this skill when a project does not yet have the AI-Forward Pack and you want the first install to respect the repository that already exists. It reads the target before writing, applies the pack deployment map, and reports what landed. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#get-started) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-addpacktorepo) |
| adopt | Repository maintainer or first-time adopter | Use this skill after the pack is installed in a project that already has code and docs. It inventories what exists, recovers the architecture, adds graph frontmatter to worthwhile documents, and creates an adoption plan for gaps. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#get-started) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-adopt) |
| also | Person directing an agent's work | Use this utility when you remember an important addition after a task has started. It captures the addition and folds it into the current work only where it belongs. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#workflow) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-also) |
| apply-learnings | Team or pack maintainer improving the working method | Use this skill after dream has promoted general, control-bearing learnings. It reconciles those learnings into target repositories and writes reviewable plans. It never merges or executes changes in the targets. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#improvement) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-apply-learnings) |
| auditlog | Engineer continuing or handing over a project | Use this utility to inspect the committed audit and change log: recent work, decisions, searches, exact past prompts and the local timeline viewer. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#knowledge) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-auditlog) |
| code-hygiene | Engineer implementing or repairing an existing system | Use this skill to identify dead code, commented-out code and recurring anti-patterns, then plan or execute cleanup without turning hygiene into risky churn. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#workflow) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-code-hygiene) |
| collectknowledge | Engineer or technical lead shaping a change | Use this skill when a project needs domain understanding before it can safely specify or design. It gathers external and internal knowledge into structured Markdown that later workflows can cite. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#design) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-collectknowledge) |
| compile | Person directing an agent's work | Use this utility when a prose request is too ambiguous to hand directly to a workflow or worker. It turns the request into a goal state, traced clauses, assumptions and decision requests without adding scope. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#workflow) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-compile) |
| define-architecture | Engineer or technical lead shaping a change | Use this skill when a project or major capability needs a top-level architecture: components, boundaries, data representation, integration contracts, AI tiering and durable decisions. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#design) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-define-architecture) |
| design-slice | Engineer or technical lead shaping a change | Use this skill to turn a specification or architecture decision into a technical blueprint for one feature or component. It names contracts, data shapes, patterns, errors, concurrency, telemetry and tests before implementation begins. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#design) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-design-slice) |
| document | Engineer continuing or handing over a project | Use this skill to generate or refresh the documentation bundle: API reference, diagrams, architecture overview, Docs Explorer index and browsable documentation view. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#knowledge) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-document) |
| dream | Team or pack maintainer improving the working method | Use this skill to run an offline consolidation pass over committed history, defect classes, mitigations and markers. It proposes learnings; humans approve, edit, reject or defer before anything is promoted. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#improvement) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-dream) |
| execute-with-coordination | Owner or coordinator of multiple tracks | Use this skill to execute a prepared coordination plan. The coordinator opens or briefs workers, watches seams, verifies returned evidence and joins the work. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#coordination) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-execute-with-coordination) |
| extendaibundle | Team or pack maintainer improving the working method | Use this skill when you want to add or change the pack itself: a new skill, knowledge doc, template, script or adapter behavior. It runs the pack-change loop so every surface stays in sync. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#improvement) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-extendaibundle) |
| forensicreview | Engineer implementing or repairing an existing system | Use this skill for a deep review of an existing codebase. It rebuilds the picture from code and docs, checks architecture, design, implementation and documentation, and produces a prioritized remediation backlog. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#workflow) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-forensicreview) |
| implement | Engineer implementing or repairing an existing system | Use this skill after the requirement and design are clear enough to code. It implements through test-first increments, verifies the real behavior and produces evidence for review. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#workflow) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-implement) |
| investigate | Engineer implementing or repairing an existing system | Use this skill when something is broken, slow, inconsistent or surprising. It reproduces or characterizes the symptom, proves the root cause, sweeps for siblings, proposes repair phases and then stops for human review. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#workflow) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-investigate) |
| migrate | Engineer implementing or repairing an existing system | Use this skill for dependency upgrades, framework migrations and large refactors. It characterizes current behavior first, migrates in small vertical increments, and records intentional differences. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#workflow) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-migrate) |
| optimize-graph | Person directing an agent's work | Use this skill to turn a multi-step request into an execution graph: real dependencies, serial work, possible parallelism, budgets, loop exits and checkpoints. It optimizes for completeness and rigor before speed. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#workflow) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-optimize-graph) |
| prepare-for-coordination | Owner or coordinator of multiple tracks | Use this skill before assigning work to several agents or humans. It classifies artifacts, identifies what must stay serial, and writes the coordination plan that execution will follow. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#coordination) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-prepare-for-coordination) |
| prompts | Engineer continuing or handing over a project | Use this utility to browse logged prompts newest-first and copy one for paste-and-edit. It is a reuse lens over the audit log, not a command that reruns work automatically. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#knowledge) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-prompts) |
| searchprompts | Engineer continuing or handing over a project | Use this utility when you remember words from a previous prompt and want to reuse the exact text. It is the filtered companion to prompts. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#knowledge) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-searchprompts) |
| session-profiler | Team or pack maintainer improving the working method | Use this skill to profile local harness telemetry and turn it into findings and fixes for cost, context growth, re-reads, task drift, fan-out and cross-harness coordination. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#improvement) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-session-profiler) |
| specify | Engineer or technical lead shaping a change | Use this skill when you need the “what” and “why” of a change before anyone designs or implements it. It turns a prompt into a specification with functional, UX and UI layers, explicit non-goals and acceptance criteria. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#design) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-specify) |
| ui-design | Engineer or designer responsible for a user-facing surface | Use this skill when the interface itself needs craft: direction, information architecture fit, visual language, states, accessibility and a reviewable mockup. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#interfaces) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-ui-design) |
| updatepack | Repository maintainer or first-time adopter | Use this skill when a repository already has AI-Forward and you want to refresh it to a newer local pack revision without hand-copying files or losing local deviations. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#get-started) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-updatepack) |
| visualize | Engineer or designer responsible for a user-facing surface | Use this skill to produce imagery, fictional personas, direction boards or motion that a surface displays. It never generates the interface itself. | [Guide](../portal/index.html#interfaces) | [Reference](../portal/index.html#skill-visualize) |
